business_problem: McCormick’s aging intranet could not reach all employees, lacked personalization and modern media support, and required IT help for content updates, limiting employee engagement across a global workforce.
solution_summary: McCormick rebuilt its aging intranet around Viva Connections to create a mobile-first employee portal that can reach staff across 150 countries and territories. Viva Connections now acts as the serving layer for multimedia content, search, personalized communications, and content management, while Microsoft Teams integration helps the portal sit inside existing collaboration habits instead of competing with them. The communications team can publish and update content without depending on IT, and built-in analytics show monthly users, site visits, and content popularity so the portal can be adjusted continuously. Rather than a top-down brochureware site, MKC Connect became a governed digital workplace channel with cross-functional approvals and daily content updates. The result is a more scalable internal communications platform that keeps employees informed, improves discoverability of corporate content, and gives McCormick an analytics-driven base for future personalization.

solution_components.name: Viva Connections
solution_components.role: Hosts the employee portal, mobile-first content experience, search, and analytics for MKC Connect.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Provides the surrounding collaboration environment that Viva Connections integrates with.

data_flow: Communications content is published into Viva Connections, employees consume it through the portal and Teams, and analytics on users, visits, and content popularity feed back into ongoing portal updates and personalization decisions.
business_outcome: McCormick created a much more accessible and measurable employee communications channel, reaching over 10,000 users per month and giving the company a stronger foundation for future personalization.
